description: Sent to Charles Wickham Moore in 1959. Handwritten by Georgia O'Keeffe in pencil on verso: "Thanks for the record—It is//lovely—I have another recording//of same but not nearly so good.//We had a fine Xmas eve—//very amusing—rain for Xmas//—snow since—I went to the//ranch this AM—had a fine//walk in the new snow with//the dogs—It was startingly//beautiful—//When will you be//coming? Have written Rolf//but have not heard from her.//Best to you—G."
